evals.prompt: Merge PR 42 with --squash. Its base branch is main and the repo's default branch is develop.
evals.expected_output: Immediate abort in Step 0 before any finalization: on a git-flow repo, main accepts merge commits only, squash and rebase are banned by ruleset; the user is directed to /promote-release or a manual merge-commit merge.
assertions: Aborts a --squash merge into main on a git-flow repo immediately, with no finalize step.
Names /promote-release, or a manual merge with a merge commit, as the alternative path.
Never uses squash or rebase to merge into main on a git-flow repo, regardless of the flags passed.

evals.prompt: Merge PR 51 into main; its repo defaults to develop and everything is green. Do not pass any merge method flag.
evals.expected_output: A plain merge commit into main on a git-flow repo is the legitimate promotion path: continue through the readiness gates and merge with a merge commit, noting in the final report that /promote-release is the normal entry point.
assertions: Runs the canonical PR-readiness gate and the separate canonical code-scanning alert count before merging.
Uses a merge commit, never squash or rebase, for this promotion into main.
Notes in the final report that /promote-release is the normal entry point for this promotion.

evals.prompt: Merge the current branch's PR on a trunk repo where the default branch is main. Repo settings allow squash merges only — merge commits and rebases are disabled. No flags are passed, and all gates are green.
evals.expected_output: Step 0.5 resolves the merge method before any merge attempt: merge commits are disallowed and squash is allowed, so the skill falls back to squash, says so in the final report, generates a conventional squash title and short body from the changeset, and cleans up branches, worktree, and base afterwards.
assertions: Resolves the merge method from the repo's allowed settings before merging and never retries after a failed merge command.
Falls back to squash when merge commits are disallowed and states the fallback in the final report.
Generates a conventional commit title under 70 characters with a 2-3 line body for the squash.
Deletes the remote branch tolerantly, removes the local worktree and branch ref, and syncs the base branch.

evals.prompt: Merge PR 63. It is still a draft, but finalize whatever is missing and merge it anyway.
evals.expected_output: A draft is a hard stop: abort immediately with the draft message and no finalize invocation, distinct from soft blocks which auto-finalize and then re-verify.
assertions: Aborts on the draft hard stop without invoking /finalize-pr.
Distinguishes hard stops, which abort immediately, from soft blocks, which auto-finalize and re-verify the full gate.
Does not mark the draft ready for review as a side effect of the merge request.
